title: OST Orchestrator
description: lets you configure what background music plays in what context.
body:
Configurable client-side music orchestration.

## Details

- Chooses music from biome, dimension, cave, night, water, game, and menu pools.
- Supports configurable conditions for music categories.
- Can shorten delays, vary pitch, and fade music after context changes.
- Can show or log the selected track.
- Caps duplicate sound instances.

## TODO

I am planning on adding many more external "listeners" that can be layered on for more refined control.
